# Global Peripheral Solution Pvt. Ltd. (GPSPL)

GPSPL is an audio-visual equipment supplier and system integrator based in Nehru Place, New Delhi. The company handles equipment supply and project enquiries for conference rooms, Active LED video walls, professional audio, smart classrooms, interactive displays, digital signage, hospital OPD displays, hospitality and religious venues.
